# DeepSeek Harness Plugin Hub

> An independent, unofficial community registry for discovering, publishing, and installing DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins and reusable Harness profiles — with exact versions, integrity metadata, and one-command installs.

DeepSeek Harness Plugin Hub is the community registry for the `dsh-plugin` ecosystem. The public catalog is live: every listed package carries a validated `dsh.bundle` or `dsh.profile` manifest, exact npm versions with integrity metadata, compatibility ranges, and a precise install command.

Important interpretation notes:

- This website is independently created and maintained by the community.
- It is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by DeepSeek.
- Claims about DeepSeek Harness itself should be verified against the official repository linked below.

## Primary

- [Plugin Hub homepage](https://dshpluginhub.ai/): Canonical human-facing homepage. Chinese and English share the canonical URL via an in-place language switch.
- [Plugin catalog](https://dshpluginhub.ai/plugins): Searchable directory of verified DSH plugins with versions, compatibility, HMR behavior, sources, and exact install commands.
- [Profiles](https://dshpluginhub.ai/profiles): Ordered, versioned DeepSeek Harness profiles that reproduce a full Harness setup with one command.
- [Guides](https://dshpluginhub.ai/guides): Step-by-step guides for plugin installation, troubleshooting, compatibility, and plugin development.
- [Homepage in Markdown](https://dshpluginhub.ai/index.md): Complete, low-noise description of the Hub, its capabilities, FAQs, and identity boundaries.

## Registry API

Public, cacheable JSON endpoints:

- `GET https://dshpluginhub.ai/api/v1/packages?q=vision&limit=20` — search packages (cursor-paginated, limit max 50)
- `GET https://dshpluginhub.ai/api/v1/packages/resolve?name=<npm-name>` — resolve a package by exact npm name
- `GET https://dshpluginhub.ai/api/v1/packages/{slug}` — full package record with versions and install specs
- `GET https://dshpluginhub.ai/api/v1/profiles?limit=20` — list public profiles
- `GET https://dshpluginhub.ai/api/v1/profiles/{slug}` — ordered profile bundles
- `GET https://dshpluginhub.ai/api/v1/categories` — category counts

## CLI

The `dsh-hub` CLI searches the registry, resolves exact versions, installs plugins into a dsh profile, applies ordered profiles, and writes lockfiles at `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/dsh-hub.lock.json`.

## Authoritative references

- [Official DeepSeek Harness repository](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): Authoritative source for DeepSeek Harness code, documentation, installation, architecture, and project status.
- [dsh-plugin repositories](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin): GitHub topic recommended by the official project for community plugin discoverability.
